description: This file implements AES encryption and decryption classes using the mbedtls library, supporting multiple modes such as ECB, CBC, CFB8, CFB128, and OFB. It includes methods for setting keys, encrypting, and decrypting data, and manages internal state like IV and mode-specific parameters.

classes.name: AESEncryption
classes.description: Class providing AES encryption functionalities supporting multiple modes, managing key setup and encryption process.

classes.name: AESDecryption
classes.description: Class providing AES decryption functionalities supporting multiple modes, managing key setup and decryption process.

methods.name: Key
methods.description: Sets the encryption key for AES operations, supporting key lengths of 128, 192, and 256 bits.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts input data of specified length using the configured AES mode and key.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts input data of specified length using the configured AES mode and key.
